craft_notes: Sthāyin: naming coherent lordship. Device: em-dash→comma (naming softens onto standing). Rejected: 'call' for 'yield' — killed: yield kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: That seamless, that seemly, that single, reasoned,
in thee, lord, stands yield of yielders-up.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tad abhaṅgi tad agrāmyaṃ tad ekam upapattimat tvayi karmaphalanyāsakṛtām aiśvaryam īśa yat
